sentences.en: The hotel breakfast buffet features crispy bacon and scrambled eggs.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店的自助早餐提供酥脆的培根和炒蛋。

sentences.en: We have been sourcing our bacon from a local farm for three years.
sentences.zh: 三年來我們一直從當地農場採購培根。

sentences.en: If you want a healthier option, turkey bacon will be served instead.
sentences.zh: 如果您想要更健康的選擇，我們將改供應火雞培根。

sentences.en: The chef was frying bacon when the fire alarm suddenly went off.
sentences.zh: 主廚正在煎培根時，火災警報器突然響了。

sentences.en: They had already consumed all the bacon before the guests arrived.
sentences.zh: 在客人抵達之前，他們已經把所有的培根吃光了。

sentences.en: The new barber in town offers excellent grooming services for professionals.
sentences.zh: 鎮上新來的理髮師為專業人士提供極佳的修容服務。

sentences.en: Mr. Smith is getting his hair cut by his favorite barber right now.
sentences.zh: 史密斯先生現在正由他最喜歡的理髮師剪頭髮。

sentences.en: I will visit the barber tomorrow to prepare for my upcoming job interview.
sentences.zh: 我明天會去理髮師那裡為即將到來的工作面試做準備。

sentences.en: By the time he opened his own shop, he had worked as a barber for a decade.
sentences.zh: 當他開設自己的店面時，他已經當了十年的理髮師。

sentences.en: Has the barber finished trimming your beard yet?
sentences.zh: 理髮師已經修剪完你的鬍子了嗎？

sentences.en: Please replace the broken bulb in the conference room before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 請在會議前更換會議室裡壞掉的電燈泡。

sentences.en: Our company has switched to energy-efficient LED bulbs to reduce costs.
sentences.zh: 我們公司已經改用節能的LED燈泡以降低成本。

sentences.en: The maintenance worker was installing a new bulb when the power failed.
sentences.zh: 維修人員正在安裝新燈泡時停電了。

sentences.en: These smart bulbs can be controlled directly from your smartphone.
sentences.zh: 這些智慧燈泡可以直接從您的智慧型手機控制。

sentences.en: They will have replaced all the old bulbs by the end of this month.
sentences.zh: 到這個月底，他們將會更換所有舊的燈泡。

sentences.en: The executive team rented a luxurious cabin for their weekend retreat.
sentences.zh: 高階主管團隊為他們的週末靜修租了一間豪華小木屋。

sentences.en: Flight attendants are preparing the cabin for departure.
sentences.zh: 空服員正在準備客艙以供起飛。

sentences.en: We will be staying in a cozy cabin near the lake next winter.
sentences.zh: 明年冬天我們將住在湖畔一間舒適的小木屋裡。

sentences.en: After they had cleaned the cabin, they started a fire in the fireplace.
sentences.zh: 在他們打掃完小木屋後，他們在壁爐裡生了火。

sentences.en: Have you ever considered building a cabin in the woods?
sentences.zh: 你曾考慮過在樹林裡建一間小木屋嗎？

sentences.en: The factory's chimney emits a significant amount of smoke every day.
sentences.zh: 這家工廠的煙囪每天排放大量的煙霧。

sentences.en: They are cleaning the chimney to prevent any potential fire hazards.
sentences.zh: 他們正在清理煙囪以防止任何潛在的火災隱患。

sentences.en: A bird had built its nest in our chimney before winter arrived.
sentences.zh: 在冬天到來之前，有隻鳥在我們的煙囪裡築了巢。

sentences.en: We will need a professional to inspect the chimney next week.
sentences.zh: 我們下週需要請專業人士來檢查煙囪。

sentences.en: Smoke was rising from the chimney when we approached the house.
sentences.zh: 當我們靠近那棟房子時，煙正從煙囪升起。

sentences.en: Please use a clip to secure these important documents together.
sentences.zh: 請用夾子將這些重要文件固定在一起。

sentences.en: The manager showed a short video clip during the presentation.
sentences.zh: 經理在簡報時播放了一小段影片剪輯。

sentences.en: She was clipping the coupons when the mail carrier knocked on the door.
sentences.zh: 當郵差敲門時，她正在剪折價券。

sentences.en: I will clip the relevant articles from the newspaper for your reference.
sentences.zh: 我會從報紙上剪下相關文章供您參考。

sentences.en: He has already clipped all the loose wires to the wall.
sentences.zh: 他已經用夾子把所有鬆脫的電線固定在牆上了。

sentences.en: In English grammar, 'equipment' is an uncountable noun, but 'tool' is countable.
sentences.zh: 在英文文法中，'equipment' 是不可數名詞，但 'tool' 是可數的。

sentences.en: The mistakes in the financial report are fortunately countable.
sentences.zh: 幸運的是，財務報告中的錯誤寥寥可數。

sentences.en: Teachers always remind students to check if a noun is countable.
sentences.zh: 老師總是提醒學生檢查名詞是否可數。

sentences.en: We have identified a countable number of issues in the current system.
sentences.zh: 我們在現有系統中發現了數量可數的問題。

sentences.en: If the items were countable, the inventory process would be much easier.
sentences.zh: 如果這些物品是可數的，盤點過程會容易得多。

sentences.en: The amusement park features a magical show with fairies and elves.
sentences.zh: 這座遊樂園有一場以仙子和精靈為主題的魔幻表演。

sentences.en: She dressed up as a fairy for the company's annual costume party.
sentences.zh: 她在公司的年度變裝派對上打扮成小仙子。

sentences.en: My daughter has always believed that a tooth fairy visits at night.
sentences.zh: 我女兒一直相信牙仙子會在晚上來訪。

sentences.en: They were telling fairy stories to the children when it started to rain.
sentences.zh: 開始下雨時，他們正在給孩子們講小仙子的故事。

sentences.en: The designer will create a fairy-themed window display for the holidays.
sentences.zh: 設計師將為假期設計一個以仙子為主題的櫥窗展示。

sentences.en: The startup's rapid success sounded like a corporate fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 這家新創公司的迅速成功聽起來像是一個企業童話。

sentences.en: He doesn't believe in the fairy tale that hard work always guarantees wealth.
sentences.zh: 他不相信努力工作就一定能致富的童話。

sentences.en: Their marketing campaign was heavily inspired by a classic fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 他們的行銷活動深受一個經典童話故事的啟發。

sentences.en: By the time the movie ended, it had completely reimagined the fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 到電影結束時，它已經徹底重新詮釋了這個童話故事。

sentences.en: We are planning to publish a modern business fairy tale next year.
sentences.zh: 我們計畫明年出版一本現代商業童話。

sentences.en: The city council has organized a spectacular firework display for New Year's Eve.
sentences.zh: 市議會為跨年夜組織了一場壯觀的煙火表演。

sentences.en: We were watching the firework show when the sudden rainstorm hit.
sentences.zh: 我們正在看煙火秀時，突然下起了暴雨。

sentences.en: They will set off fireworks to celebrate the grand opening of the mall.
sentences.zh: 他們將施放煙火來慶祝購物中心的盛大開幕。

sentences.en: The company had never sponsored a firework event before last year.
sentences.zh: 在去年之前，這家公司從未贊助過煙火活動。

sentences.en: Safety regulations must be strictly followed when handling fireworks.
sentences.zh: 處理煙火時必須嚴格遵守安全規定。

sentences.en: Every department is required to have a fully stocked first-aid kit.
sentences.zh: 每個部門都必須配備一個裝滿用品的急救箱。

sentences.en: She grabbed the first-aid kit immediately after her colleague cut his finger.
sentences.zh: 在同事割傷手指後，她立刻拿來了急救箱。

sentences.en: We will update the supplies in all first-aid kits tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我們明天將更新所有急救箱裡的用品。

sentences.en: The safety officer has just inspected the first-aid kit in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 安全主任剛剛檢查過倉庫裡的急救箱。

sentences.en: They were looking for a first-aid kit when the ambulance arrived.
sentences.zh: 救護車抵達時，他們正在尋找急救箱。

sentences.en: The price of gasoline has reached four dollars per gallon this week.
sentences.zh: 本週汽油價格已達到每加侖四美元。

sentences.en: We need to order several gallons of paint for the office renovation.
sentences.zh: 我們需要訂購幾加侖的油漆來裝修辦公室。

sentences.en: The machine had processed hundreds of gallons of water before it broke down.
sentences.zh: 這台機器在故障前已經處理了數百加侖的水。

sentences.en: They are pumping a gallon of fuel into the generator right now.
sentences.zh: 他們現在正將一加侖的燃料抽入發電機中。

sentences.en: By the end of the day, the restaurant will have used twenty gallons of cooking oil.
sentences.zh: 到今天結束時，這家餐廳將用掉二十加侖的食用油。

sentences.en: The manager gave a gentle reminder about the upcoming project deadline.
sentences.zh: 經理對即將到來的專案截止日期給予了溫和的提醒。

sentences.en: Please use a gentle detergent to wash these delicate fabrics.
sentences.zh: 請使用溫和的洗滌劑來清洗這些嬌貴的布料。

sentences.en: He was speaking in a gentle voice to calm the angry customer.
sentences.zh: 他正用溫和的聲音說話以安撫憤怒的顧客。

sentences.en: The transition to the new software has been remarkably gentle for the staff.
sentences.zh: 對員工來說，過渡到新軟體的過程非常平順。

sentences.en: We will adopt a more gentle approach in our future negotiations.
sentences.zh: 我們在未來的談判中將採取更溫和的方法。

sentences.en: The agricultural company grows organic tomatoes in a temperature-controlled greenhouse.
sentences.zh: 這家農業公司在控溫溫室中種植有機番茄。

sentences.en: They are building a new greenhouse to expand their floral business.
sentences.zh: 他們正在建造一個新的溫室以擴展花卉業務。

sentences.en: We had completely repaired the greenhouse before the winter storms arrived.
sentences.zh: 在冬季風暴來臨之前，我們已經完全修復了溫室。

sentences.en: The automated system will monitor the humidity inside the greenhouse continuously.
sentences.zh: 自動化系統將持續監測溫室內的濕度。

sentences.en: Researchers have tested various fertilizers in the greenhouse this year.
sentences.zh: 研究人員今年在溫室裡測試了各種肥料。

sentences.en: The environmental report highlighted the severe impact of the greenhouse effect.
sentences.zh: 這份環境報告強調了溫室效應的嚴重影響。

sentences.en: Scientists are discussing how to mitigate the greenhouse effect during the summit.
sentences.zh: 科學家們正在高峰會期間討論如何減緩溫室效應。

sentences.en: Our corporation has pledged to reduce emissions that contribute to the greenhouse effect.
sentences.zh: 我們公司已承諾減少會加劇溫室效應的排放物。

sentences.en: If we don't act now, the greenhouse effect will cause irreversible damage.
sentences.zh: 如果我們現在不採取行動，溫室效應將造成不可逆轉的損害。

sentences.en: They had studied the greenhouse effect for years before publishing their findings.
sentences.zh: 在發表研究結果之前，他們已經研究溫室效應多年了。

sentences.en: The CEO got a neat haircut before the annual shareholders' meeting.
sentences.zh: 執行長在年度股東大會前理了一個俐落的髮型。

sentences.en: I am getting a haircut this afternoon to look professional for the conference.
sentences.zh: 我今天下午要去理髮，為了在會議上看起來更專業。

sentences.en: He desperately needs a haircut because his bangs are covering his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他極需理髮，因為他的瀏海都遮住眼睛了。

sentences.en: She had given herself a bad haircut before going to a professional salon.
sentences.zh: 在去專業沙龍之前，她自己剪了一個很糟的髮型。

sentences.en: Will you get a haircut before the photoshoot next week?
sentences.zh: 下週拍照前你會去理髮嗎？

sentences.en: The famous hairdresser charges a premium for styling celebrities.
sentences.zh: 這位著名的美髮師為名人做造型收取高額費用。

sentences.en: I have been visiting the same hairdresser since I moved to this city.
sentences.zh: 自從我搬到這個城市以來，我一直光顧同一位美髮師。

sentences.en: My hairdresser suggested a new color treatment to cover the gray hair.
sentences.zh: 我的美髮師建議用新的染髮療程來遮蓋白髮。

sentences.en: They are hiring an experienced hairdresser for their new boutique salon.
sentences.zh: 他們正在為新的精品沙龍聘請一位經驗豐富的美髮師。

sentences.en: By the time the wedding started, the hairdresser had styled all the bridesmaids.
sentences.zh: 婚禮開始時，美髮師已經為所有伴娘做好了造型。

sentences.en: Changing your hairstyle can sometimes boost your confidence at work.
sentences.zh: 改變髮型有時能提升你在工作上的自信。

sentences.en: She is sporting a modern hairstyle that matches her dynamic personality.
sentences.zh: 她頂著一個符合她充滿活力個性的現代髮型。

sentences.en: The fashion magazine featured the most popular corporate hairstyles of the year.
sentences.zh: 這本時尚雜誌介紹了年度最受歡迎的企業界髮型。

sentences.en: He will have to adopt a more conservative hairstyle for his new role.
sentences.zh: 為了他的新職位，他將必須採用更保守的髮型。

sentences.en: They had debated about the actor's hairstyle before finalizing the film's look.
sentences.zh: 在確定電影造型之前，他們曾對演員的髮型進行過討論。

sentences.en: The marketing team hatched a brilliant plan to increase sales over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊策劃了一個絕妙的計畫來增加假期的銷售額。

sentences.en: The engineers are checking the escape hatch on the newly designed submarine.
sentences.zh: 工程師正在檢查新設計潛艇上的逃生艙門。

sentences.en: The eggs had already hatched by the time the researchers returned to the lab.
sentences.zh: 當研究人員回到實驗室時，卵已經孵化了。

sentences.en: We will open the cargo hatch as soon as the plane is safely parked.
sentences.zh: 飛機一安全停妥，我們就會打開貨艙門。

sentences.en: A new startup idea was hatching in his mind during the conference.
sentences.zh: 在會議期間，一個新的新創點子正在他腦海中醞釀(孵化)。

sentences.en: The manufacturer uses hollow steel tubes to reduce the overall weight of the bike.
sentences.zh: 製造商使用中空的鋼管以減輕自行車的整體重量。

sentences.en: His apology sounded hollow after making the same mistake repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 在屢次犯下同樣的錯誤後，他的道歉聽起來很虛偽(空洞)。

sentences.en: They are hollowing out the wooden block to create a custom instrument.
sentences.zh: 他們正在把木塊挖空，以製作客製化樂器。

sentences.en: The hikers took shelter in a small hollow to escape the sudden rain.
sentences.zh: 登山客躲進一個小坑洞裡以躲避突如其來的雨。

sentences.en: By tomorrow, the machine will have hollowed all the plastic molds.
sentences.zh: 到明天，機器將會挖空所有的塑膠模具。

sentences.en: The hotel housekeeper ensured that every room was spotless before check-in time.
sentences.zh: 飯店管家確保每個房間在入住時間前都一塵不染。

sentences.en: We are currently seeking a reliable housekeeper for our executive retreat center.
sentences.zh: 我們目前正在為高階主管靜修中心尋找一位可靠的管家。

sentences.en: The housekeeper had organized the entire closet before the guests arrived.
sentences.zh: 在客人抵達前，管家已經把整個衣櫥整理好了。

sentences.en: She has worked as a head housekeeper at this resort for over a decade.
sentences.zh: 她已經在這家度假村擔任首席管家超過十年了。

sentences.en: Will the housekeeper restock the minibar this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 管家今天下午會補充迷你吧的飲料嗎？

sentences.en: The colleagues shared a quick hug to celebrate the successful product launch.
sentences.zh: 同事們迅速擁抱了一下，慶祝產品成功發表。

sentences.en: She is hugging her old friend whom she hasn't seen since college.
sentences.zh: 她正擁抱著自大學以來就沒見過面的老朋友。

sentences.en: He gave his daughter a tight hug before boarding his business flight.
sentences.zh: 在搭乘商務航班前，他緊緊地擁抱了女兒。

sentences.en: They had hugged each other warmly before signing the partnership agreement.
sentences.zh: 在簽署合作協議之前，他們熱情地擁抱了對方。

sentences.en: I will hug my parents as soon as I arrive at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我一到機場就會擁抱我的父母。

sentences.en: The indigenous tribe lives in a small hut built from bamboo and leaves.
sentences.zh: 這個原住民部落住在用竹子和樹葉建造的小屋裡。

sentences.en: We rented a beach hut to store our surfing gear for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們租了一間海灘小屋來存放週末的衝浪裝備。

sentences.en: The guide was waiting by the wooden hut when the tourists arrived.
sentences.zh: 當遊客到達時，嚮導正在木屋旁等候。

sentences.en: They will construct a temporary hut to serve as a command center during the festival.
sentences.zh: 他們將建造一個臨時小屋作為慶典期間的指揮中心。

sentences.en: The storm had completely destroyed the fishing hut before dawn.
sentences.zh: 黎明前，風暴已經完全摧毀了那間釣魚小屋。

sentences.en: The wildlife park in Australia allows visitors to feed the kangaroos.
sentences.zh: 澳洲的野生動物園允許遊客餵食袋鼠。

sentences.en: A kangaroo hopped across the road while we were driving to Sydney.
sentences.zh: 當我們開車前往雪梨時，一隻袋鼠跳過了馬路。

sentences.en: They have been studying the behavior of red kangaroos for several years.
sentences.zh: 他們已經研究紅大袋鼠的行為好幾年了。

sentences.en: The company uses a kangaroo logo to emphasize its Australian heritage.
sentences.zh: 這家公司使用袋鼠標誌來強調其澳洲傳統。

sentences.en: We will see plenty of kangaroos if we visit the sanctuary tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 如果我們明天去保護區，就會看到很多袋鼠。

sentences.en: The new employee was given a welcome kit containing a mug, notebook, and pen.
sentences.zh: 新進員工收到了一個包含馬克杯、筆記本和筆的迎新禮包(工具組)。

sentences.en: You should always keep an emergency repair kit in your vehicle.
sentences.zh: 你應該隨時在車裡放一套緊急維修工具箱。

sentences.en: The marketing team is assembling a press kit for the upcoming product launch.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊正在為即將到來的產品發表會組合媒體公關包。

sentences.en: He had already purchased a DIY furniture kit before reading the complex instructions.
sentences.zh: 在閱讀複雜的說明書之前，他已經買了一組DIY家具組。

sentences.en: We will distribute the testing kits to all regional clinics by next Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們將在下週五前將檢測試劑盒分發給所有區域診所。

sentences.en: The conservation group successfully rescued a koala from the bushfire.
sentences.zh: 保育團體成功從叢林大火中救出一隻無尾熊。

sentences.en: Koalas sleep up to twenty hours a day to conserve their energy.
sentences.zh: 無尾熊每天睡覺長達二十小時以保存體力。

sentences.en: We were observing a koala chewing eucalyptus leaves when the guide called us.
sentences.zh: 當嚮導叫我們時，我們正在觀察一隻無尾熊咀嚼尤加利葉。

sentences.en: The zoo has launched a campaign to sponsor koala habitats.
sentences.zh: 動物園發起了一項贊助無尾熊棲息地的活動。

sentences.en: By the time we reached the sanctuary, the koalas had finished their meal.
sentences.zh: 當我們到達保護區時，無尾熊們已經吃完飯了。

sentences.en: Please ensure that every shipping box has a clear barcode label.
sentences.zh: 請確保每個運輸箱上都有清晰的條碼標籤。

sentences.en: The FDA requires food manufacturers to label all artificial ingredients accurately.
sentences.zh: 美國食品藥物管理局要求食品製造商準確標示所有人工成分。

sentences.en: He was labeling the chemical samples when the supervisor entered the lab.
sentences.zh: 當主管進入實驗室時，他正在為化學樣品貼標籤。

sentences.en: Our products have been labeled as eco-friendly by a recognized organization.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品已被公認機構歸類(貼上標籤)為環保產品。

sentences.en: We will label the discounted items with a bright red sticker.
sentences.zh: 我們將用鮮紅色的貼紙標示打折商品。

sentences.en: The bridal boutique imports high-quality lace from France for its custom gowns.
sentences.zh: 這家婚紗精品店從法國進口高品質蕾絲來製作訂製禮服。

sentences.en: He is lacing up his running shoes to prepare for the charity marathon.
sentences.zh: 他正在綁緊跑鞋的鞋帶，準備參加慈善馬拉松。

sentences.en: The vintage dress was decorated with intricate white lace around the collar.
sentences.zh: 這件復古洋裝的領口周圍裝飾著精緻的白色蕾絲。

sentences.en: By the time the race started, his shoelace had completely unraveled.
sentences.zh: 比賽開始時，他的鞋帶已經完全鬆開了。

sentences.en: She will lace the fabric tightly to give the corset its proper shape.
sentences.zh: 她將把布料綁緊，使馬甲呈現適當的形狀。

sentences.en: The student does his washing at the local laundromat every Sunday evening.
sentences.zh: 這位學生每個星期天晚上都在當地的自助洗衣店洗衣服。

sentences.en: They are planning to open a 24-hour laundromat in the busy downtown area.
sentences.zh: 他們計畫在繁華的市中心開一家24小時營業的自助洗衣店。

sentences.en: I was waiting for my clothes to dry at the laundromat when I read the report.
sentences.zh: 當我在自助洗衣店等衣服烘乾時，我閱讀了那份報告。

sentences.en: The laundromat had already closed by the time he finished his night shift.
sentences.zh: 當他結束大夜班時，自助洗衣店已經關門了。

sentences.en: We will need to get quarters before heading to the laundromat.
sentences.zh: 去自助洗衣店之前，我們需要先換一些25美分的硬幣。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a complimentary laundry service for its VIP guests.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店為VIP貴賓提供免費的洗衣服務。

sentences.en: She has been doing the laundry all morning to prepare for her business trip.
sentences.zh: 她整個早上都在洗衣服，為了出差做準備。

sentences.en: Please put your dirty clothes in the laundry basket behind the door.
sentences.zh: 請把你換下來的髒衣服放在門後的洗衣籃裡。

sentences.en: The laundry was folded and placed in the closet before he arrived home.
sentences.zh: 在他到家前，洗好的衣物已經摺好並放在衣櫥裡了。

sentences.en: We will drop off the suits at the dry laundry tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我們明天會把西裝送到乾洗店。

sentences.en: The plumber fixed the leak in the office bathroom to prevent water damage.
sentences.zh: 水電工修好了辦公室洗手間的漏水，以防止水災。

sentences.en: A prominent journalist leaked the confidential merger documents to the press.
sentences.zh: 一位知名記者將機密的合併文件洩漏給了新聞界。

sentences.en: Gas is leaking from the pipeline, so the area must be evacuated immediately.
sentences.zh: 氣體正從管線中滲漏，因此必須立即疏散該區域。

sentences.en: The company had investigated the data leak before releasing an official statement.
sentences.zh: 公司在發表官方聲明之前，已經調查了資料外洩事件。

sentences.en: We will install new seals to ensure the container does not leak.
sentences.zh: 我們將安裝新的密封件，以確保容器不會滲漏。

sentences.en: The new tech hub has become a magnet for talented software engineers.
sentences.zh: 新的科技中心已成為吸引優秀軟體工程師的磁鐵。

sentences.en: We use a strong industrial magnet to separate the metal scrap on the conveyor belt.
sentences.zh: 我們使用強力的工業磁鐵來分離輸送帶上的金屬廢料。

sentences.en: He is attaching the presentation notes to the whiteboard with a magnet.
sentences.zh: 他正用磁鐵將簡報筆記固定在白板上。

sentences.en: The souvenir shop had sold out of refrigerator magnets before noon.
sentences.zh: 這家紀念品店在中午前就把冰箱磁鐵賣光了。

sentences.en: Will this giant magnet affect the electronic equipment nearby?
sentences.zh: 這塊巨大的磁鐵會影響附近的電子設備嗎？

sentences.en: You cannot bring a large nail clipper in your carry-on luggage at some airports.
sentences.zh: 在某些機場，你不能將大型指甲剪帶入隨身行李中。

sentences.en: He bought a high-quality stainless steel nail clipper from the pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 他從藥局買了一把高品質的不鏽鋼指甲剪。

sentences.en: She was using the nail clipper when the phone suddenly rang.
sentences.zh: 當電話突然響起時，她正在使用指甲剪。

sentences.en: I had misplaced my nail clipper before packing my travel bag.
sentences.zh: 在整理旅行袋之前，我把指甲剪放錯地方了。

sentences.en: We will include a small nail clipper in the hotel amenity kit.
sentences.zh: 我們會在飯店備品包中放一把小指甲剪。

sentences.en: The zoo's marketing campaign heavily features the newly arrived giant panda.
sentences.zh: 動物園的行銷活動大量主打新到來的大熊貓。

sentences.en: Researchers have been tracking the panda population in the wild for decades.
sentences.zh: 研究人員數十年來一直在追蹤野外的熊貓數量。

sentences.en: A panda was eating bamboo peacefully while the tourists took numerous photos.
sentences.zh: 當遊客拍下無數照片時，一隻熊貓正平靜地吃著竹子。

sentences.en: The conservation center will release the captive-bred panda into the mountains next year.
sentences.zh: 保育中心明年會將人工繁殖的熊貓放歸山林。

sentences.en: They had established a panda sanctuary long before the species became endangered.
sentences.zh: 早在該物種瀕臨滅絕之前，他們就已經建立了一個熊貓保護區。

sentences.en: The logistics company experiences its peak season right before the winter holidays.
sentences.zh: 物流公司在寒假前正好迎來旺季(巔峰期)。

sentences.en: Demand for electric vehicles is expected to peak within the next five years.
sentences.zh: 對電動車的需求預計將在未來五年內達到巔峰。

sentences.en: She reached the peak of her acting career after winning the international award.
sentences.zh: 在贏得國際大獎後，她達到了演藝事業的巔峰。

sentences.en: They were climbing the mountain peak when the weather suddenly deteriorated.
sentences.zh: 當天氣突然惡化時，他們正在攀登頂峰。

sentences.en: Stock prices had peaked just before the central bank announced the interest rate hike.
sentences.zh: 就在中央銀行宣布升息之前，股價已經達到了頂點。

sentences.en: The CEO presented her with a stunning pearl necklace for her retirement.
sentences.zh: 執行長送給她一條驚豔的珍珠項鍊作為退休禮物。

sentences.en: Our new software application is the pearl of the company's portfolio.
sentences.zh: 我們的新軟體應用程式是公司產品組合中的明珠。

sentences.en: He dropped a few pearls of wisdom during the orientation session.
sentences.zh: 他在新生訓練時分享了一些金玉良言。

sentences.en: These cultured pearls are imported directly from Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 這些養殖珍珠是直接從東南亞進口的。

sentences.en: She has always preferred subtle jewelry, like a simple pearl earring.
sentences.zh: 她總是偏好低調的珠寶，像是一對簡單的珍珠耳環。

sentences.en: He ordered a pint of beer after a long day of negotiations.
sentences.zh: 經過漫長的一天談判後，他點了一品脫啤酒。

sentences.en: Please buy a pint of milk from the grocery store on your way home.
sentences.zh: 請你在回家的路上從雜貨店買一品脫牛奶。

sentences.en: The bartender poured a perfect pint for the regular customer.
sentences.zh: 酒保為常客倒了一杯完美的品脫啤酒。

sentences.en: We consume several pints of cream every week in the bakery.
sentences.zh: 我們麵包店每週會消耗好幾品脫的鮮奶油。

sentences.en: They celebrated their successful merger by sharing a few pints at the local pub.
sentences.zh: 他們在當地酒吧喝了幾杯啤酒，慶祝合併成功。

sentences.en: The marketing team designed a creative poster for the upcoming seminar.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊為即將到來的研討會設計了一張富有創意的海報。

sentences.en: Please ensure the promotional posters are displayed in the lobby.
sentences.zh: 請確保大廳展示了宣傳海報。

sentences.en: We are printing 500 posters to advertise the new product launch.
sentences.zh: 我們正在印製500張海報來宣傳新產品發佈。

sentences.en: The vintage poster on the wall gives the cafe a unique atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 牆上的復古海報賦予了這家咖啡館獨特的氛圍。

sentences.en: He was tasked with distributing posters across different university campuses.
sentences.zh: 他的任務是在不同的大學校園發放海報。

sentences.en: He bought a new electric razor to speed up his morning routine.
sentences.zh: 他買了一把新的電動刮鬍刀以加快他早上的準備時間。

sentences.en: The hotel provides complimentary razors and shaving cream upon request.
sentences.zh: 飯店可應要求提供免費的刮鬍刀和刮鬍泡。

sentences.en: Be careful when using that razor, as it is extremely sharp.
sentences.zh: 使用那把刮鬍刀時要小心，因為它非常鋒利。

sentences.en: The company manufactures high-quality razors for men and women.
sentences.zh: 該公司生產供男女使用的高品質刮鬍刀。

sentences.en: I need to replace my disposable razor before the business trip.
sentences.zh: 在出差前，我需要更換我的拋棄式刮鬍刀。

sentences.en: You should change the razor blade regularly for a smoother shave.
sentences.zh: 你應該定期更換刮鬍刀片以獲得更滑順的刮鬍體驗。

sentences.en: He accidentally cut his chin because the razor blade was too dull.
sentences.zh: 他不小心割傷了下巴，因為刮鬍刀片太鈍了。

sentences.en: The pharmacy sells packs of razor blades at a discounted price.
sentences.zh: 藥局以折扣價出售包裝好的刮鬍刀片。

sentences.en: She carefully disposed of the used razor blade in a safe container.
sentences.zh: 她小心地將用過的刮鬍刀片丟棄在安全的容器中。

sentences.en: Modern razor blades are designed with advanced technology to prevent irritation.
sentences.zh: 現代的刮鬍刀片採用先進技術設計，以防止皮膚過敏。

sentences.en: Our sales usually reach their peak during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 我們的銷售額通常在假日季節達到巔峰。

sentences.en: The athlete has finally reached her peak after years of rigorous training.
sentences.zh: 經過多年的嚴格訓練，這位運動員終於達到了她的巔峰狀態。

sentences.en: His career reached its peak when he was appointed as the regional director.
sentences.zh: 當他被任命為區域總監時，他的職業生涯達到了巔峰。

sentences.en: The demand for this model is expected to reach its peak next month.
sentences.zh: 預計對這款車型的需求將在下個月達到巔峰。

sentences.en: Stock prices reached their peak before the economic downturn began.
sentences.zh: 股價在經濟衰退開始前達到了最高點。

sentences.en: We bought some ready-made sandwiches for a quick lunch at the office.
sentences.zh: 我們買了一些現成的三明治，在辦公室快速解決午餐。

sentences.en: The boutique offers both tailor-made suits and ready-made garments.
sentences.zh: 這家精品店提供量身訂做的西裝和現成的服裝。

sentences.en: There is no ready-made solution for this complex logistical problem.
sentences.zh: 對於這個複雜的物流問題，沒有現成的解決方案。

sentences.en: She relied on a ready-made template to create the presentation slides.
sentences.zh: 她依賴現成的範本來製作簡報投影片。

sentences.en: Ready-made meals have become increasingly popular among busy professionals.
sentences.zh: 現成餐點在忙碌的專業人士中變得越來越受歡迎。

sentences.en: The audit report revealed several discrepancies in the financial statements.
sentences.zh: 審計報告揭露了財務報表中的幾處差異。

sentences.en: She refused to reveal the details of the confidential agreement.
sentences.zh: 她拒絕透露這份機密協議的細節。

sentences.en: The company will reveal its latest smartphone model at the expo tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 公司將於明天的博覽會上揭曉其最新款智慧型手機。

sentences.en: A recent survey reveals that customer satisfaction has dropped significantly.
sentences.zh: 一項最近的調查顯示，顧客滿意度已大幅下降。

sentences.en: His facial expression revealed his disappointment with the quarterly results.
sentences.zh: 他的臉部表情透露出他對季度業績的失望。

sentences.en: They served grilled sausages and scrambled eggs for the business breakfast.
sentences.zh: 他們在商務早餐中供應烤香腸和炒蛋。

sentences.en: The local butcher makes the best spicy Italian sausage in town.
sentences.zh: 當地的肉舖做出了鎮上最棒的辣味義大利香腸。

sentences.en: We ordered a large pizza with pepperoni, mushrooms, and sausage.
sentences.zh: 我們點了一個有義大利辣味香腸、蘑菇和香腸的大披薩。

sentences.en: The food processing plant produces thousands of sausages daily.
sentences.zh: 這家食品加工廠每天生產數千條香腸。

sentences.en: She decided to try the traditional German sausage at the market.
sentences.zh: 她決定在市場上品嚐傳統的德國香腸。

sentences.en: The shopkeeper greeted every customer with a warm and friendly smile.
sentences.zh: 店老闆以熱情友好的微笑迎接每一位顧客。

sentences.en: Local shopkeepers are protesting against the new tax regulations.
sentences.zh: 當地的商店老闆們正在抗議新的稅收規定。

sentences.en: The shopkeeper agreed to give us a discount if we bought in bulk.
sentences.zh: 如果我們大量購買，店主人同意給我們折扣。

sentences.en: As a diligent shopkeeper, he always ensures the shelves are fully stocked.
sentences.zh: 身為一名勤奮的店老闆，他總是確保貨架上備滿了商品。

sentences.en: The experienced shopkeeper knows exactly what her clients need.
sentences.zh: 這位經驗豐富的店老闆確切地知道她的客戶需要什麼。

meaning: n. 義大利麵(類似油麵粗細的麵條)

sentences.en: We had spaghetti with meatballs for dinner after the long conference.
sentences.zh: 在漫長的會議結束後，我們的晚餐吃了肉丸義大利麵。

sentences.en: The Italian restaurant downtown is famous for its authentic spaghetti.
sentences.zh: 市區那家義大利餐廳以其道地的義大利麵而聞名。

sentences.en: He accidentally spilled spaghetti sauce on his white dress shirt.
sentences.zh: 他不小心把義大利麵醬灑在了他的白色襯衫上。

sentences.en: Boil the spaghetti for about ten minutes until it is al dente.
sentences.zh: 將義大利麵煮約十分鐘，直到口感彈牙。

sentences.en: They offer a gluten-free option for those who cannot eat regular spaghetti.
sentences.zh: 他們為那些不能吃一般義大利麵的人提供無麩質的選擇。

meaning: n. 香料, n. 情趣、風味, vt. 加香料於~, vt. 為~增添情趣、風味

sentences.en: The chef added a special blend of spices to enhance the dish's flavor.
sentences.zh: 主廚加入了一種特別混合的香料以提升菜餚的風味。

sentences.en: We need to spice up our marketing campaign to attract younger consumers.
sentences.zh: 我們需要為行銷活動增添一些趣味，以吸引年輕消費者。

sentences.en: India is globally recognized for exporting a wide variety of spices.
sentences.zh: 印度因出口種類繁多的香料而聞名全球。

sentences.en: A little friendly competition can add some spice to the workplace.
sentences.zh: 一點友善的競爭可以為職場增添一些情趣。

sentences.en: The soup was too bland, so I spiced it up with some black pepper.
sentences.zh: 湯太清淡了，所以我加了一些黑胡椒來調味。

sentences.en: The rescue team saved the abandoned animals before they could starve.
sentences.zh: 救援隊在被遺棄的動物餓死之前救了牠們。

sentences.en: If we don't secure the funding, our project will starve for resources.
sentences.zh: 如果我們沒有獲得資金，我們的專案將會缺乏資源。

sentences.en: During the severe drought, many crops failed and livestock began to starve.
sentences.zh: 在嚴重乾旱期間，許多農作物歉收，牲畜開始餓死。

sentences.en: They tried to starve the enemy forces by cutting off their supply lines.
sentences.zh: 他們試圖切斷敵軍的補給線來使他們挨餓。

sentences.en: No one should have to starve in a society with abundant food production.
sentences.zh: 在一個糧食生產豐富的社會裡，任何人都不應該挨餓。

sentences.en: Let's order some food right now; I am absolutely starving after that meeting.
sentences.zh: 我們現在就點些吃的吧；開完那場會議後我快餓死了。

sentences.en: The organization provides meals for starving children in developing countries.
sentences.zh: 該組織為開發中國家飢餓的兒童提供膳食。

sentences.en: We found a starving kitten in the alley and took it to the vet.
sentences.zh: 我們在小巷裡發現了一隻快餓死的小貓，並帶牠去看了獸醫。

sentences.en: He worked through his lunch break and was starving by late afternoon.
sentences.zh: 他午休時間也在工作，到了傍晚時分已經餓壞了。

sentences.en: The hikers were freezing and starving when they finally reached the cabin.
sentences.zh: 登山客終於抵達小木屋時，他們又冷又餓。

sentences.en: World leaders gathered at the economic summit to discuss global trade.
sentences.zh: 世界各國領導人齊聚經濟高峰會，討論全球貿易。

sentences.en: The climbers successfully reached the summit of Mount Everest on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 登山者於星期二成功登頂聖母峰。

sentences.en: An emergency summit was called to address the sudden financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 為應對突發的金融危機，召開了緊急高峰會。

sentences.en: She is at the summit of her career, highly respected by all her peers.
sentences.zh: 她正處於職業生涯的巔峰，受到所有同行的極高尊敬。

sentences.en: The environmental summit resulted in a landmark agreement on carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 環境高峰會促成了一項關於碳排放的里程碑協議。

meaning: 吊牌標籤；加上標籤、附上籤條；（在社群媒體上）標記

sentences.en: Please check the price tag before you bring the item to the cashier.
sentences.zh: 在將商品拿到收銀台之前，請先檢查價格標籤。

sentences.en: Don't forget to tag our official account when you post the event photos.
sentences.zh: 發布活動照片時，別忘了標記我們的官方帳號。

sentences.en: All luggage must be properly tagged with the passenger's contact information.
sentences.zh: 所有行李都必須正確貼上包含乘客聯絡資訊的標籤。

sentences.en: She cut off the tag from her new dress because it was scratching her neck.
sentences.zh: 她剪掉了新洋裝上的吊牌，因為它刮到了她的脖子。

sentences.en: The warehouse staff tags every newly arrived pallet with a barcode.
sentences.zh: 倉庫工作人員會為每個新到的棧板貼上條碼標籤。

sentences.en: Do you mind if I tag along to the networking event tonight?
sentences.zh: 你介意我今晚跟著去參加那個社交活動嗎？

sentences.en: Her younger brother always tries to tag along when she goes out with friends.
sentences.zh: 她和朋友出去時，她弟弟總是想跟著去。

sentences.en: I decided to tag along on the business trip to assist with the presentation.
sentences.zh: 我決定跟隨去出差，以協助進行簡報。

sentences.en: He let the intern tag along to observe how client meetings are conducted.
sentences.zh: 他讓實習生跟隨旁觀，以觀察如何進行客戶會議。

sentences.en: They are going to the trade fair, and I might just tag along to see the exhibits.
sentences.zh: 他們要去參加貿易展，我也許會跟著去看看展品。

sentences.en: He took his new trousers to the tailor to have them hemmed.
sentences.zh: 他把新褲子拿到裁縫那裡去改短褲管。

sentences.en: A skilled tailor can make a suit fit perfectly on any body shape.
sentences.zh: 技術熟練的裁縫可以製作出完美貼合任何身型的西裝。

sentences.en: We need to find a reliable tailor to alter the uniforms for our staff.
sentences.zh: 我們需要找一位可靠的裁縫來修改我們員工的制服。

sentences.en: The tailor measured his shoulders carefully before cutting the expensive fabric.
sentences.zh: 在裁剪昂貴的布料之前，裁縫仔細地測量了他的肩膀。

sentences.en: Her grandfather worked as a master tailor in London for over forty years.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父在倫敦擔任了四十多年的大師級裁縫。

meaning: a. 訂做的、量身打造的

sentences.en: We offer tailor-made financial solutions to meet our clients' specific needs.
sentences.zh: 我們提供量身打造的財務解決方案，以滿足客戶的特定需求。

sentences.en: He wore a beautiful tailor-made suit to the awards ceremony.
sentences.zh: 他穿著一套漂亮的訂做西裝出席頒獎典禮。

sentences.en: This training program is tailor-made for newly hired mid-level managers.
sentences.zh: 這個培訓計畫是為新聘的中階主管量身打造的。

sentences.en: They enjoyed a tailor-made vacation package that included all their favorite activities.
sentences.zh: 他們享受了一個量身訂做的度假方案，其中包含了所有他們喜歡的活動。

sentences.en: The consultant provided a tailor-made strategy to improve our online sales.
sentences.zh: 顧問提供了一套量身打造的策略，以提升我們的線上銷售額。

sentences.en: Colleagues would often tease him about his obsession with color-coded folders.
sentences.zh: 同事們經常取笑他對用顏色分類資料夾的執著。

sentences.en: Please don't tease the new employee for making a minor mistake.
sentences.zh: 請不要因為新員工犯了一個小錯誤就取笑他。

sentences.en: She knew they were just teasing her, but she still felt a bit embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 她知道他們只是在跟她開玩笑，但她還是覺得有點尷尬。

sentences.en: The boss likes to playfully tease the team when they exceed their targets.
sentences.zh: 當團隊超越目標時，老闆喜歡開玩笑地取笑他們。

sentences.en: Children shouldn't be allowed to maliciously tease their classmates.
sentences.zh: 不應允許孩子們惡意取笑他們的同學。

meaning: a. 溫柔的, a. (肉質) 軟嫩

sentences.en: The steak was so tender that it practically melted in my mouth.
sentences.zh: 這牛排非常軟嫩，幾乎是入口即化。

sentences.en: He sent a tender message to his wife on their tenth anniversary.
sentences.zh: 在他們十週年紀念日，他傳了一則溫柔的訊息給妻子。

sentences.en: Cook the chicken slowly on low heat to ensure it remains tender and juicy.
sentences.zh: 用小火慢煮雞肉，以確保它保持軟嫩多汁。

sentences.en: The CEO surprised everyone with his tender response to the tragedy.
sentences.zh: 執行長對這場悲劇的溫柔回應讓每個人都感到驚訝。

sentences.en: She had a tender heart and often volunteered at the local animal shelter.
sentences.zh: 她有一顆溫柔的心，經常在當地的動物收容所做義工。

meaning: n. 溫柔、(肉質) 軟嫩

sentences.en: The chef marinated the beef overnight to maximize its tenderness.
sentences.zh: 主廚將牛肉醃製過夜以使其達到最軟嫩的狀態。

sentences.en: She spoke with such tenderness that it calmed the nervous applicant immediately.
sentences.zh: 她說話時帶著無比的溫柔，立刻安撫了緊張的求職者。

sentences.en: The restaurant is renowned for the remarkable tenderness of its lamb chops.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳以其羊排令人驚豔的軟嫩度而聞名。

sentences.en: His actions demonstrated a surprising tenderness toward his elderly parents.
sentences.zh: 他的行為表現出對年邁父母令人驚訝的溫柔。

sentences.en: We test the meat's tenderness using specialized culinary equipment.
sentences.zh: 我們使用專門的烹飪設備來測試肉的軟嫩度。

meaning: a. (肉) 硬的, a. 困難的, a. 不屈的、強硬的

sentences.en: It was a tough decision to close down the underperforming branch.
sentences.zh: 關閉表現不佳的分公司是一個艱難的決定。

sentences.en: The meat was overcooked and far too tough to chew properly.
sentences.zh: 這塊肉煮得太老了，硬得無法好好咀嚼。

sentences.en: Our new manager is known for being a tough negotiator in contract discussions.
sentences.zh: 我們的新經理在合約討論中以作風強硬的談判專家而聞名。

sentences.en: Despite the tough market conditions, the startup managed to secure funding.
sentences.zh: 儘管市場環境艱困，這家新創公司仍設法獲得了資金。

sentences.en: She has had a tough year, but her resilience helped her pull through.
sentences.zh: 她度過了艱難的一年，但她的韌性幫助她度過了難關。

meaning: n. 家教, vt. 擔任家教、(個別) 指導

sentences.en: They hired a private tutor to help their son improve his math grades.
sentences.zh: 他們請了一位私人英家教來幫助他們的兒子提高數學成績。

sentences.en: She used to tutor college students in economics during her free time.
sentences.zh: 她過去常在空閒時間擔任大學生的經濟學家教。

sentences.en: The online platform connects freelance tutors with students worldwide.
sentences.zh: 這個線上平台將自由接案的家教與世界各地的學生聯繫起來。

sentences.en: He tutored the new recruit on how to operate the complicated machinery.
sentences.zh: 他親自指導新進員工如何操作這台複雜的機器。

sentences.en: Becoming a language tutor is a great way to earn extra income on weekends.
sentences.zh: 成為語言家教是在週末賺取額外收入的好方法。

sentences.en: In English grammar, words like 'water' and 'information' are uncountable nouns.
sentences.zh: 在英語文法中，像「水」和「資訊」這樣的詞是不可數名詞。

sentences.en: The universe contains an almost uncountable number of stars.
sentences.zh: 宇宙包含了幾乎數不清的星星。

sentences.en: She has made uncountable contributions to the success of this charity.
sentences.zh: 她為這個慈善機構的成功做出了不可勝數的貢獻。

sentences.en: Please note that 'furniture' is considered uncountable and does not take an 's'.
sentences.zh: 請注意，「家具」被視為不可數，因此不加 's'。

sentences.en: There are uncountable reasons why we should invest in renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 我們應該投資再生能源的原因多得數不清。

meaning: n. 蠟, vt. 塗、打蠟, vt. 熱蠟除毛

sentences.en: We need to wax the conference room floor before the executives arrive.
sentences.zh: 我們需要在高層抵達之前為會議室的地板打蠟。

sentences.en: The artisan used high-quality beeswax to make these scented candles.
sentences.zh: 工匠使用高品質的蜂蠟來製作這些香氛蠟燭。

sentences.en: She went to the salon to get her legs waxed before the beach holiday.
sentences.zh: 在去海灘度假之前，她去了美容院做腿部熱蠟除毛。

sentences.en: Applying a layer of wax will protect your car's paint from the elements.
sentences.zh: 塗上一層蠟可以保護你的車漆免受天氣因素的影響。

sentences.en: The museum features incredibly realistic figures made entirely out of wax.
sentences.zh: 這家博物館展出完全由蠟製成的、極其逼真的人物模型。

meaning: n. 雜草, vi./vt. 除草, vt. 剔除、淘汰

sentences.en: We need to weed out the unqualified candidates during the first interview round.
sentences.zh: 我們需要在第一輪面試時淘汰掉不合格的候選人。

sentences.en: He spent the entire Saturday morning weeding his vegetable garden.
sentences.zh: 他花了整個星期六早上在他的菜園裡除草。

sentences.en: The gardener applied a safe chemical to prevent weeds from growing on the lawn.
sentences.zh: 園丁施用了一種安全的化學物質來防止草坪上長出雜草。

sentences.en: It is essential to weed through the incoming emails to find the urgent ones.
sentences.zh: 仔細篩選收到的電子郵件以找出緊急的郵件是必要的。

sentences.en: These invasive weeds are destroying the native plants in the local park.
sentences.zh: 這些入侵的雜草正在破壞當地公園裡的原生植物。

sentences.en: The price of wheat has increased significantly due to the recent droughts.
sentences.zh: 由於近期的乾旱，小麥價格大幅上漲。

sentences.en: Our bakery prides itself on using only organic whole wheat flour.
sentences.zh: 我們麵包店引以為豪的是只使用有機全麥麵粉。

sentences.en: The country is one of the world's leading exporters of corn and wheat.
sentences.zh: 該國是世界上主要的玉米和小麥出口國之一。

sentences.en: They harvested the golden wheat fields just before the heavy rains started.
sentences.zh: 他們在大雨開始前收割了金黃色的小麥田。

sentences.en: Many people with celiac disease must avoid products containing wheat.
sentences.zh: 許多患有乳糜瀉的人必須避免食用含有小麥的產品。

meaning: n. 口哨, n. 哨子, vi./vt. 吹口哨, vi./vt. 吹哨子

sentences.en: The factory supervisor blew his whistle to signal the end of the shift.
sentences.zh: 工廠主管吹響了哨子，示意換班結束。

sentences.en: He likes to whistle a cheerful tune while he walks to the office.
sentences.zh: 他喜歡在走向辦公室時吹著歡快的口哨。

sentences.en: The referee blew the whistle and awarded a penalty kick to the home team.
sentences.zh: 裁判吹響哨子，判給主隊一個十二碼罰球。

sentences.en: You can hear the train whistle blowing from miles away in this quiet town.
sentences.zh: 在這個安靜的小鎮裡，你可以在幾英里外聽到火車的鳴笛聲。

sentences.en: She learned how to whistle loudly using two fingers to hail a cab.
sentences.zh: 她學會了如何用兩根手指大聲吹口哨來叫計程車。

sentences.en: The novel's antagonist is a wicked corporate executive trying to steal the patent.
sentences.zh: 這部小說的反派是一個試圖竊取專利的邪惡企業高層。

sentences.en: She gave him a wicked grin before revealing her brilliant marketing strategy.
sentences.zh: 在透露她出色的行銷策略之前，她對他露出了一個淘氣的笑容。

sentences.en: The villagers believed the old abandoned castle was cursed by a wicked witch.
sentences.zh: 村民們相信那座廢棄的古堡被一個邪惡的女巫詛咒了。

sentences.en: They had a wicked sense of humor that kept the team laughing during stressful times.
sentences.zh: 他們有一種促狹的幽默感，讓團隊在充滿壓力的時期也能開懷大笑。

sentences.en: It was considered a wicked act to betray your business partners for personal gain.
sentences.zh: 為了個人利益而出賣商業夥伴被視為一種邪惡的行為。
